directions: From Tralee test centre on Spa Road, move off and take the 1st right to stay on Spa Road
Continue to the end of the road and turn right onto Caher Anne Road
Take the next right into Cluain Ard, a quiet housing estate often used for the reverse or turnabout manoeuvre
Drive to the end of Cluain Ard and turn right, then be ready to perform a U-turn where directed before continuing back out to the left
